info.title: WeGo Place discovery - proposed Phase 3 contract
info.description: SPECIFICATION ONLY: none of these operations is implemented in the audited backend. See PHASE-3-PLACES-CONTRACT.md. Distinguishes persistent INTERNAL/USER IDs and transient GOOGLE previews. Trip membership/day scheduling and Google materialization belong to Phase 4.

get.summary: Owner-scoped Trip context, internal Province catalog; no AI/provider calls.

404.description: TRIP_001: trip missing, deleted or owned by someone else

get.summary: Google predictions for names/addresses in Vietnam; no coordinates or DB writes.

429.description: PLACE_003: application rate limit; preserve query/selection

Retry-After.description: Seconds until application retry is allowed

503.description: PLACE_004: provider unavailable, timeout, quota or not configured

get.description: Trim q; latitude/longitude must both be supplied or both omitted. Limit to up to 5 place predictions; do not include query predictions. Location bias is not a hard city restriction. Session token is not an authentication credential.

post.summary: Resolve one prediction to a transient Google preview; no internal UUID is created.
